newsitem.title: USA: Continental in Colgan Air code-sharing pact.
newsitem.headline: Continental in Colgan Air code-sharing pact.

text.p: Continental Airlines Inc said Wednesday that has entered into a code-share agreement with Colgan Air Inc effective this summer on flights connecting in Boston, New York's La Guardia Airport, and Charlotte, N.C.
The company said Colgan Air will serve as a Continental Connection regional airline providing service throughout the Northeast and the Mid-Atlantic regions with over 60 flights daily.
Under the terms of the agreement, Continental said it will handle all reservations for Colgan Air and all flights will appear as Continental flight numbers.
Colgan Air is headquartered in Manassas, Va. and provides service to nine states and 15 cities, operating a fleet of seven 19-passenger Beechcraft 1900s.
